purpose: CMF material board showing fabric, wood, soft-touch plastic, LED diffuser, and sage accent
prompt:
Industrial design CMF (Color, Material, Finish) board for an elderly AI companion device, presented as a beautiful material mood board on warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

Layout: 5 material swatches arranged in an aesthetically pleasing composition — not a rigid grid, but an editorial layout with varying sizes, like a Kinfolk magazine spread.

Swatch 1 (largest, top-left): "Acoustic Fabric" — A beautiful close-up of fine linen weave in warm cream #F5F0E8. Show the tactile quality — soft, warm, inviting. The weave is fine and regular, not burlap. Occupies about 30% of the board.

Swatch 2 (top-right): "Light Oak Wood" — Natural light oak wood surface in honey tone #C4A882, showing beautiful grain patterns. Open-pore finish, not glossy. The wood looks warm and hand-smooth. About 20% of board.

Swatch 3 (center): "Soft-Touch Matte" — Warm gray #D4CFC7 matte surface with ultra-fine sand texture. Looks velvety and warm, not plastic-y. Shows how it diffuses light softly. About 15% of board.

Swatch 4 (bottom-left): "LED Diffuser Glow" — A translucent material with warm amber #E8B87A light glowing through it. Soft radial gradient, no visible LED dots. Looks like warm candlelight trapped in frosted glass. About 15% of board.

Swatch 5 (bottom-right, small accent): "Sage Accent" — A muted sage green #A8B5A0 fabric or matte surface, used as a secondary accent for health/calm indicators. About 10% of board.

Between swatches: small detail photos showing material junctions — where fabric meets wood, where button meets body. All transitions smooth.

Overall mood: warm, tactile, natural, premium. Like touching expensive natural materials. Warm 2700K lighting throughout. No clinical or tech aesthetic.
